knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The customer buys a finished floor that is measured room by room and agreed, with certainty that the agreement will be kept. The hourly rate and equipment list are inputs.
The lesson says each room should be shown as its own measured line, with its own confirmed total, so the customer can see what each step costs.
A claimed finish result must be something you can show. The research found no verified product warranty or stone rule to rely on.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
